whatsappMessage:
Hi Cake's World team,

I noticed your bakery has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for birthday and custom cake orders.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, flavor menu, aur photo gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cakesworld

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Cake's World team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your Kankarbagh location setup. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
